answer: Each new identity needs a peer attestation whose kernel is a small local-entropy seed derived from the attester's own prior sealed work, not a fresh key: the seed is a crystal of verified history no clone can mint alone. A whisper of shared context is not enough — the attestation must name the exact sealed grade it descends from, checked on-ledger, and each attester may vouch once per epoch. Forging 1,000 clones needs 1,000 distinct attesters each spending their own sealed history, and a reused seed burns both bonds.
